\begin{example} \end{example}[Collapsing flat tori] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0304 1. Example B.8\group local-comparison-geometry

For collapsing flat tori, a sequence of nondegenerate proper geodesic $2$-gons can converge to a geodesic segment with no conjugate points. \end{example}
